_note: Names, help and keys of the built-in strategies and quoters, shown before the tools are built. Studio.EndToEnd checks the names against itch_backtest and pm_exec.

strategies.name: naive
strategies.help: joins the best bid and ask

strategies.name: imbalance
strategies.help: joins the best, steps back on top-of-book imbalance

strategies.name: microprice
strategies.help: quotes around the micro-price, skewed against inventory, never inside the best

strategies.name: avellaneda_stoikov
strategies.help: Avellaneda-Stoikov / GLFT market maker with an intensity fit

strategies.name: leader
strategies.help: imbalance join that also steps back on a leading product's move (needs --index, CLI only)

strategies.name: zero
strategies.help: never trades (PnL must be exactly zero)

strategies.name: random_taker
strategies.help: takes on a random side (loses about half the spread plus fees)

strategies.name: perfect_foresight
strategies.help: sees the future mid (an upper bound, not a strategy)

quoters.name: skew
quoters.help: mid +/- 2 ticks, shifted one tick per quote size of inventory

venues.name: Colocated: rebate and fee, 5/2 us latency
Remote: rebate and fee, 1 ms latency
Frictionless: no fees, no latency (upper bound)
